Subject: Invoice HLX-2026-07 / VAT allocation question

Hi Laura / Helix payments team,

Hope you are well. Attached is invoice HLX-2026-07 for services delivered in Q4 2026 (total: EUR 128,560). Our records show the invoice is past due (net30) — payment was due 2027-04-28.

Two quick asks so we can close this out:
- Can you confirm whether Helix will apply reverse-charge VAT for this invoice (i.e., Helix self-accounting), or whether Redwood should issue the invoice with local VAT applied?
- If reverse-charge is being used, please confirm the internal PO/approval that will trigger the payment and an expected payment date.

If useful, we can accept a partial payment now and the balance after the VAT confirmation; happy to propose a short payment plan.

Attachment: Helix_INV-2026-07.pdf (invoice, 125KB)

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.inference | +1 415 555 0198

From: Laura McIntyre <laura@helixhealth.com>

Cc: procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: 2027-05-22T14:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice HLX-2026-07 / VAT allocation question

Jonas,

Thanks for following up. Per our tax team, we expect to reverse-charge VAT on services received from non-EU suppliers where applicable. However, before we release payment we need:
1) Redwood's VAT registration certificate (EU or non-EU VAT id) for our records;
2) A VAT breakdown on the invoice (VATable base vs. VAT line) or confirmation that the invoice is net and will be self-accounted for by Helix.

We do not intend to pay the VAT portion until we have the documentation; we can proceed with the net portion if Redwood provides the requested evidence.

Can you provide the VAT certificate and an annotated invoice?

Best,
Laura McIntyre
Head of Finance Operations
Helix Health
laura@helixhealth.com

- Send Redwood's VAT registration (attached) and an annotated invoice showing net vs VAT.
- Offer a 70/30 split: 70% now, remainder within 30 days of final VAT confirmation / PO amendment.
- If Helix refuses partial payment and stalls past 05/27, Marissa to authorize an escalation email to the Helix CFO and hold customer on dunning stage 3 (legal notice).
